v: na॰ UhagAne 1 pra॰ darSite sAmaBede “rOravayODAjaye vArhate BavataH” SrutiH ।
m: यौधाजय n. N. of various Sāmans, Br.
यौध mf(ई)n. (fr. योध) warlike, martial, Lāṭy.

s: puM, (yoDamarhatIti । yoDa + QaY । yadbA, “pArSvAdiyODeyAdiByAmaRaYO .” 5 । 3 । 117 । iti svArTe aY .) yodDA । iti sidDAntakOmukI ॥ (yuDizWiraputtraH । sa ca SEvyarAjadOtritraH । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 95 । 76 । “yuDizWirastu govAsanasya SEvyasya devikAM nAma kanyAM svayambarAM leBe । tasyAM puttraM janayAmAsa yODeyaM nAma ॥” nfgarAjaputtrAH yODeyA iti KyAtAH । yaTA, harivaMSe । 31 । 25 । “dfzadbatyAstu saMjajYe SivirOSInaro nfpaH । Sivestu SivayastAta ! yODeyAstu nfgasya ha ॥”)
v: pu॰ yoDa eva AyuDajIvisaMGatvAt svArTe Qak 1 yodDari । 2 uttarasTadeSaBede pu॰ vf॰ sa॰ 14 a॰ । buDAyAH apatyam “dvyacaH” pA॰ Qak । 2 yuDAyA apatye । tataHsvArTe aY SArNgara॰ striyAM NIn । yODeyI ।
m: यौधेय m. (prob. fr. योध) a warrior, soldier, L.
(pl.) N. of a warlike race, MBh.; Hariv. &c.
a king of the Yaudheyas (f(ई). ), Pāṇ. iv, 1, 178
N. of a son of Yudhiṣṭhira, MBh.
यौधेयक m. pl. = यौधेय, VarBṛS.
यौधिक See योधिक, p. 858, col. 2.

s: tri, (yuDizWirasya idamiti । yuDizWira + aR .) yuDizWirasambanDi । yaTA, -- “sA ca yODizWirI senA gANgeyaSaratAqitA । pratipatpAWaSIlAnAM vidyeva tanutAM gatA ॥” iti mahABAratam ॥ (yuDizWirasyApatye, puM । yaTA, mahABArate । 6 । 50 । 59 । “yODizWiraH susaMkrudDaH sOvalaM niSitEH SarEH । vyadArayata saMgrAme maGavA iva dAnavam ॥” vAsudevasya patnIviSeze, strI । yaTA, harivaMSe । 160 । 20 -- 21 । “kOSikyAM sutasomAyAM yODizWiryyAM yuDizWiraH । kApAlI garuqaScEva jajYAte citrayoDinO ॥ evamAdIni puttrARAM sahasrARi niboDa me । daSAyutaM samAKyAtA vAsudevasya te sutAH ॥”)
m: यौधिष्ठिर mf(ई)n. relating or belonging to Yudhiṣṭhira, MBh.; Sāh.; Rājat.
यौधिष्ठिर m. a descendant of Yudhiṣṭhira (also pl. and f(ई). ), MBh.; Hariv.
यौधिष्ठिरि m. patr. fr. युधि-ष्ठिर, MBh. (g. बाह्व्-आदि).
यौथिक m. (fr. यूथ) ‘belonging to a troop or herd’, a companion, comrade, BhP.
a: यौथिक — a. Belonging to a flock or troop. --कः A companion, comrade.

m: यौथ्य mfn. g. संकाशादि.
1. यौग m. (fr. योग) a follower of the Yoga system of philosophy, L.
2. यौग Vṛddhi form of युग in comp.
a: यौगः — A follower of the Yoga system of philosophy.

m: यौग—ं-धराय˚णीय mfn. relating to Yaugaṃdharāyaṇa, Kathās.
यौग—ं-धरायण m. (fr. युगंधर and योगं-धर) patr. Pravar. (cf. g. नडादि)
N. of a minister of king Udayana, Mṛcch.; Ratnāv.; Kathās.
यौग—ं-धर mfn. relating to Yugaṃ-dhara (also ˚रक), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 130.
यौग—ं-धरि m. a prince of the Yugaṃ-dharas, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 173, Sch.

s: tri, (yogasyAyamiti । yoga + aR + svArTe kan .) yogasambanDI । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥
m: यौगक mfn. (fr. योग), Siddh.
यौग—पद n. = next, BhP.
यौग—पद्य n. (fr. युग-पद्) simultaneousness, ŚāṅkhŚr.; Sāh.; Pratāp. &c.
यौग—पद्येन ind. simultaneously, together, MBh.
यौग—वरत्र n. = युग-वरत्राणां समूहः, g. खण्डिकादि.

s: tri, (yogAya praBavatIti । yoga + “yogAdyacca .” 5 । 1 । 129 । iti WaY .) prakftipratyayayogalaByArTavAcakaH । yaTA । yogAya praBavati । iti yogyaH yOgikaH । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥ “yogarUQASca rUQASca yOgikASceti te triDA । AditeyAdiSabdA yOgikAH aditerapatyAnIti Qakpratyayena kevalaM yogArTa eva .” ityalaNkArakOstuBe 2 kiraRaH ॥ * ॥ (“yOgikaM nAma lakzayati viBajate ca । ‘yogalaByArTamAtrasya boDakaM nAma yOgikam । samAsastadDitAktaYca kfdantaYceti tattriDA ॥’ yannAma svAntarnnivizwaSabdAnAM yogalaByasyEva yAdfSArTasyAnvayaboDaM pratihetustannAma tAdfSArTe yOgikam । yogarUQantu kfzRasarpAdipadaM yogenAvacCinnasya rUQyarTasya boDakaM na tu tanmAtrasya । tacca yOgikaM triviDaM samAsastadDitAktaM kfdantaYceti । dvandbo'pi samAsaH svaGawakaSabdAnAmAkANkzayA laByasya DavaKadirAdyarTasyAnvayakoDakatayA yOgika eva । sarvvaYcedaM rUQAnyatvena viSezaRIyaM nAtaH kfzRasarpAdO vAsudevAdO paNkajAdO ca yogarUQe'tiprasaNgaH । brAhmaRI SvaSrUH SUdretyAdO NIbAdeH strItvavAcitve tAdfSaM nAma yOgikameva anyaTA tu strItvAdimati tattadarTe rUQameva nAto viBAgasya vyAGAtaH ॥ yOgikezu samAsaM lakzayati । ‘yAdfSasya mahAvAkyasyAntastvAdirnnijArTake । yAdfSArTasya DIhetuH sa samAsastadarTakaH ॥’ yAdfSamahAvAkyottarastvatalAdiH svArTasya yAdfSArTAvacCinnavizayatASAliboGe hetustAdfSaM tadvAkyaM taTAviDArTe samAsaH । pAcakAdikantu pAkakarttAdyarTakaM vAkyamapi svaGawakAnekanAma laByatAdfSArTakatvavirahAnna mahAvAkyam । prakftyarTamAtrAvacCinnapratyayArTasyAnvayaboDaM pratyayogyatvaM vA prakfte vAkyasya mahattvaM vAcyam । tena upakumBAdO nAvyAptirnnavA nIlaGawatvatvamityAdO nIlaGawatvAdiBAge'tiprasaNgaH । kzIrapAyItyAdikastu prakftyarTAvacCinnakfdarTasyAnvayaboDe samarTo'pi na prakftyarTamAtrAvacCinnasya tataH pAna SIlasAmAnyasyApratyayAt । rAjYaH puruzatvamityAdito rAjanyeva puruzaBAvaH pratIyate na tu rAjapuruzasya BAvaH tadDitAnAM prakftyarTamAtrAnvita svArTaboDakatvAdato rAjYaH puruzetyAdiBAge na prasaNgaH । pAyaMpAyamityAdiRamantaBAgastu svArTAvacCinnasya DAtvantarArTasyEvAnvayaboDako na tu tvAdipratyayArTasya prasTAyetyAdO samAsavyapadeSolyavAdiSabdasaMskAraprayojanako gORaH ॥” * * * * * * “yOgikezu kramaprAptaM tadDitAktaM nAma lakzayati । ‘yannAma tadDitaM yacca yatkramaM sadyadarTakam । yaddbayaM yamkramaM tatra tadDitAktaM nigadyate ॥’ yadyapi nAmottaratadDitatvaM tadDitottaranAmatvaM vA pratyekaM bahuguqo drAkzetyAdO dAkzirityAdO cAvyApakameva tadDitAkte nAmni taTApi yAdfSaM nAma yacca tadDitaM yAdfSAnupUrbyavacCinnaM sadyAdfSArTasyAnvayaboDe samarTaM tAdfSAnupUrbyavacCinnaM taddbayamapi tAdfSArTe tadDitAktaM nAmetyarTaH pacatitarAmityAdikantu nAmEva na prAgeva tu tadDitAktaM tasyApi lakzyatve yaH SabdastadDitaM yacceti paWanIyaM wAbAderapi tadDitatvopagamAdajAbrAhmaRItyAdernAsaMgraha iti vadanti । kfdantaM nAma lakzayati । ‘yadDAtvarTAnvitasvArTaDIkft kfdyAdfSaM Bavet । tadDAtUttaragaM tat kft kfdantaM nAma tAdfSam ॥’ yadDAtvarTAnvitasvArTAnvayaboDaM prati yAdfSAnupUrbyavacCinnasya yatkfto niScayaH kAraRaM tadDAtUttaragaM tat kfdeva tAdfSAnupUrbyavacCinnaM sat kfdantaM nAma । yaTA pAWakapAWyamAnAdi tadDi DAtvarTenAnvitasya svArTakarttAdeH karmmatvAdAvanvayaboDaM prati dvitIyAdyaMSe tAdfSAnupUrvvikatvenaM niScIyamAnaM hetuH cEtreRa grAmasya gantavyamityAdO DAtvarTe svArTamizwasADanatvAdikaM boDayadapi tavyAdikaM DAtvarTanizWavizayatAnirUpitasvArTavizayatAkaboDajanakatvena DAtvarTAnvitasvArTakameva BAvakftAmapi svarUpArTakatvaM vyutpAditameva ॥” iti SabdaSaktiprakASikA ॥ aguruH । tatparyyAyo yaTA, -- “ayoguruH samuddizwo yOgiko lohanAmaBiH ॥” iti gAruqe 205 aDyAyaH ॥)
v: tri॰ yogAt prakftipratyayArTasambanDAt AgataH Wak । prakftipratyayalaByArTavAcake Sabde yaTA pAcakAdiSabdaH pAkakartfbAcakaH । bogAya praBavati Wak । 2 bogabomye
m: यौगिक mf(ई)n. (fr. योग; cf. Pāṇ. v, 1, 102) useful, applicable (अ-य्˚), Kām.
belonging to a remedy, remedial, Suśr.
connected with or suiting the derivation, having an etymological meaning (यौगिकी संज्ञा f. a word retaining that signification which belongs to it according to its etymology), Pratāp.; Sarvad.
relating to or derived from the Yoga, Pañcar.
a: यौगिक — a. (की f.) [योग ठक्] 1 Useful, serviceable, proper. --2 Usual. --3 Derivative, etymological, agreeing with the derivation of the word (opp. रूढ or ‘conventional’). --4 Remedial. --5 Relating to or derived from Yoga. --Comp. --रूढ a. etymological and conventional; as उद्भिद्.

m: यौगिक—रूढ mfn. (a word) which has both an etymological and a conventional meaning, Bhāṣāp. (cf. योग-र्˚).
यौगिक—त्व n. accordance (of the meaning of a word) with its derivation or etymology, L.

s: tri, (yojanaSataM gacCatIti । yojanaSata + “kroSaSatayojanaSatayorupasaMKyAnam .” 5 । 1 । 74 । ityasya vArtti॰ iti । WaY .) yojanaSatagamanakarttA । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥ (yojanaSatAdaBigamanamarhatIti vAkye yojanaSatABigamanakarttA । iti kASikA ॥)
m: यौजनशतिक mf(ई)n. (fr. योजन + शत) one who goes a hundred Yojanas, Pāṇ. v, 1, 74, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
one who deserves to be approached from a distance of a hundred Yojanas, ib., Vārtt. 2, Pat.

s: tri, (yojanaM gacCatIti । yojana + “yojanaM gacCati .” 5 । 1 । 74 । iti WaY .) ekayojanagamanakarttA । iti sidDAntakOmudI ॥
m: यौजनिक mfn. going or extending a Yojana, Pāṇ. v, 1, 74.
यौकरीय mfn. (fr. यूकर) g. कृशाश्वादि.
यौक्ताश्व n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
यौक्तस्रुच n. (fr. युक्त + स्रुच्) N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.

s: puM, (yuktiM karotIti । yukti + WaY .) narmmasacivaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ yuktiyogye, tri ॥
v: tri॰ yuktita AgataH Wak । 1 yuktisidDe 2 yogye ca । yuktO aDikftaH Wak । 3 narmasaciye pu॰ Sabdara॰ ।
m: यौक्तिक mfn. (fr. युक्ति) suitable, proper, fit, logical, reasonable (अ-य्˚), Kap.
connective, binding, W.
usual, customary, ib.
यौक्तिक m. a king's companion or associate (= नर्म-सचिव), L.
a: यौक्तिक — a. (की f.) [युक्तित आगत ठक्] 1 Suitable, fit, proper. --2 Logical, based on argument or reasoning. --3 Deducible. --4 Usual, customary. --कः A king's boon companion; cf. नर्मसचिव.

s: klI, (yoneridamiti । yoni + aR .) yonisambanDADInapApam । yaTA । bODAyanaH । “saMvatsareRa patati patitena sahAcaran । yAjanADyApanAdyOnAt sadyo hi SayanASanAt ॥” sumantuH । yaScEtEryOnamOKaSrOvAdInAM sambanDAnAmanyatamena saha samparkamiyAt tasyApyetadeva prAyaScittaM vidaDyAditi । iyAt kuryyAt । etadeveti dvAdaSavArzikamityarTaH । atra yAjanAdInAmanyatamena saMvatsareRa patatItyavagamyate । iti prAyaScittavivekaH ॥ (utpattikAraRam । yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 102 । 25 । “yatrAgniyOnASca vasanti lokA abyonayaH parvvatayonayaSca ॥” uttarApaTajAtajAtiviSeze, puM । yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 207 । 43 । “uttarApaTajanmAnaH kIrttayizyAmi tAnapi । yOnakAmBojagAnDarAH kirAtA varvvarEH saha ॥”)
v: tri॰ yonitaH yonisambanDAt Agatam aR । 1 yonitaH prApte । yonerayamaRa । 2 vEvAhikasambanDe pu॰ । prA॰ vi॰ bODAyanaH “saMvatsareRa patati patitena sahAcaran । yAjanADyApanAd yOnAt sadyo hi SayanASanAt” । sumantuH “yaScEteryOnamOKasrOvyAdInAM sambanDAnAmanyatamena saha samparkamiyAt tasyApyetadeva prAyaScittaM vidaDyAditi” ।
m: 1. यौन mf(ई)n. (fr. योनि) relating to the womb or place of birth, uterine, W.
relating to or resulting from or connected by marriage, Mn.; MBh. &c.
यौन n. matrimonial connection, conjugal alliance, relationship by marriage, ib.
the ceremony on conception (= गर्भाधान), L.
matrimonial duties, Gobh., Sch.
(ifc.) produced from (e.g. अग्निय्˚), MBh.
2. यौन m. pl. N. of a people (prob. = यवन), MBh.
a: यौन — a. (नी f.) [योनितः योनिसंबंधात् आगतं अण्] 1 Uterine. --2 Resulting from marriage, matrimonial; Ms. 2. 40. --नं Marriage, matrimonial alliance; Ms. 11. 180.

m: यौन—सम्बन्ध m. relationship by marriage, affinity, MW.
यौनिक m. moderate wind (neither too mild nor too strong), L.
यौप mf(ई)n. relating to a sacrificial post, Bṛh.
यौप्य mfn. g. संकाशादि.
यौड् Cf. √ यौट्

s: f sambanDe । iti kavikalpadrumaH । (BvA॰para॰-saka॰-sew .) caturddaSasvarI । f, ayuyOqat । yOqati kAzWaM takzA । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

klI, (yutakayorbaDUvarayoridam । yutaka + aR । yutakameveti । svArTe aR vA .) yOtukam । iti halAyuDarAyamukuwO । 2 । 8 । 28 ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 9 । 131 । “mAtustu yOtakaM yat syAt kumArIBAga eva saH ॥” asya viSezavivaraRantu yOtukaSabde drazwavyam ॥)
v: na॰ yute vivAhakAle'Digatam vuR । vivAhakAle labDe Dane halA॰ । iti dAyaBAgAnusAriRaH । vIrami॰ tu “yu miSraRe iti DAtvanusArAt vivAhakAle ekAsanopavizwayorbaDUvarayoryad banDuBirdIyate tatyutayoridaM yOtakamiti vyutpattyA yOtakamityucyate” ityuktam ata eva niGaRwO yutayoryOtakamityuktam । anye tu vivAhe strIpuMsAvekaSaroratayA miSritO Bavata iti “asTiBirasTIni mAMsErmAMsAni” ityAdiSrutyA taTokteH vivAhena yutayoridam” ityAhuH । vastutaH vivAhakAlottaramekAsanopravizwayoreva dattaM DanaM yOtakaM lokaprasidDaM vIrami॰ uktaM sADIyaH । “mAtuSca yOtakaM yat syAt kumArI BAga eva saH” manuH ।
m: यौतक mf(ई)n. (fr. 1. युतक) rightfully or exclusively belonging to any one, being the property of any one, MBh.
यौतक n. a present, Bhojapr.

private property, (esp.) property given at marriage, a woman's dowry, presents made to a bride at her marriage by her father and friends (accord. to some also ‘a gift to the bridegroom’), Yājñ.; MBh.; Rājat.
a: यौतक — a. (की f.) [युते विवाहकाले अधिगतं वुण्] Forming the rightful or exclusive property of any one, rightfully belonging to any one; विभागभावना ज्ञेया गृहक्षेत्रैश्च यौतकैः Y. 2. 149. --कं 1 Private property in general. --2 A woman's dowry, a woman's private property (given to her at marriage); मातुस्तु यौतकं यत्स्यात्कुमारीभाग एव सः Ms. 9. 131; also यौतुक in this sense.

m: यौतकि m. patr. (f. ˚क्या) g. क्रौड्य्-आदि.

v: na॰ yu--tu yotuH tasya BAvaH aR । 1 parimARe amaraH ।
m: यौतव n. measure in general (= or v.l. for पौतव, q.v.), L.

k.v: यौतवं द्रुवयं पाय्यमिति मानार्थकं त्रयम्. मानं तुलाङ्गुलिप्रस्थैर्गुञ्जाः पञ्जाद्यमाषकः॥

m: यौत्र n. = योत्र, a tie, rope, Pat.

s: klI, yOtakam । vivAhakAle dampatyorlabDaM Danam । upacArAt annaprASanAdisaMskArakAlalabDamapi । yutakaM yonisambanDaH tatra Bavamiti zRe yOtakam । yutayorbaDUvarayoridamiti vA kaRi yOtakam ॥ yOtakamukAramaDyamapi । yOtakaM yOtukaYca tat । iti vAcaspatiH ॥ yOtakAdi tu yaddeyaM sa dAyo haraRaYca tadityatrAmarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥ * ॥ striyA yOtakaDanasyADikArakramo yaTA, -- “yatta duhitfmAtrADikArArTaM gotamavacanam । ‘strIDanaM duhitFRAmaprattAnAmapratizWitAnAYca .’ yacca nAradasya । ‘mAturdduhitaro'BAve duhitFRAM tadanvayaH ॥’ yacca kAtyAyanasyApi । ‘duhitFRAmaBAve tu rikTaM puttrezu tadBavet ॥’ yacca yAjYavalkyasya । ‘mAturduhitaraH SezamfRAttABya fte'nvayaH ॥’ tAni pUrvvoktadevalavacanaviroDena yOtakaDanamAtravizayARi । ataeva manuH । 9 । 131 ॥ ‘mAtuSca yOtakaMyat syAt kumArIBAga eva saH ॥’ yOtakaM pariRayanalabDam । yu miSraRa iti DAtoryuta iti padam । miSratA ca strIpuMsayorekaSarIratA tacca vivAhAdBavati । asTiBirasTIni mAMsErmmAMsAni tvacA tvacamiti SruteH । ato vivAhakAlalabDaM yOtakam । tataSca pariRayanalabDaM strIDanaM duhitureva na puttrARAm । tatrEva kramArTaM gotamavacanam । strIDanaM duhitFRAmaprattAnAmapratizWitAnAYca । praTamamaprattAnAM tadaBAve prattAnAM tadaBAve samUQAnAm । strIDanaM duhitFRAmitisAmAnyataH prAptatvAt । aprattAnAmityAdestu kramArTatvAt । taTA, yAjYabalkyaH । ‘aprajaHstrIDanaM BartturbrAhmyAdizu catuzvapi । duhitFRAM prasUtA cecCezezu pitfgAmi tat ॥’ tatra brAhmyAdizu vivAhezu yallabDamaDyagniDanaM striyA tat tasyAM mftAyAM praTamaM duhitFRAmeva tatrApi praTamaM kanyAyAstadaBAve prattAyAstadaBAve pariRItAyAH sarvvaduhitraBAve ca puttrasyADikAraH aprajaHstrIDane BartturaDikArAt । bfhaspatinA aprattApadena aprattAdyaBAve samUQAyA apyaDikAraH sUcitaH । ‘brAhmyadEvArzagAnDarvvaprAjApatyezu yadDanam । aprajAyAmatItAyAM Barttureva tadizyate ॥ yattvasyAH syAdDanaM dattaM vivAhezvAsurAdizu । atItAyAmaprajAyAM mAtApitrostadizyate ॥’ asyAH syAddattamiti parAcInaM pUrvvatrAnuzajyate । tena vivAhezu yadDanaM dattamiti sambanDAt vEvAhikaDanamAtrapratIterna yAvadDanavizayatvam । taTA yamaH । ‘AsurAdizu yaddravyaM vivAhezu pradIyate ॥’ vivAhakriyAyAM pUrvvAparIBUtAyAM yaddravyaM pradIyate iti yOtakaDanamAtragocaratvameva pratIyate .” iti dAyaBAgaH ॥ * ॥ “UQAyA yOtakaDane praTamaM kumArI tadaBAve vAgdattA aDikAriRI । etayoraBAve UQayoH puttravatIsamBAvitaputtrayoryugapadaDikAraH । ekABAve cAparAyAH । etayoraBAve banDyAviDavayostulyADikAraH । ekABAve cAparAyAH । tataH puttradOhitrapOttraprapOttrasapatnIputtrapOttraprapOttrARAM krameRADikAraH । granTakfnmate sapatnIputtrAnantaraM dOhitrasyADikAra iti viSezaH । tato brAhmyAdivivAhapaYcakasamayalabDayOtakaDane BarttA BrAtA mAtA pitA ceti kramaH । AsurAdivivAhatrayasamayalabDayOtakaDane mAtA pitA BrAtA BarttA ceti kramaH । tato devaraH tato devaraputtraBarttfSvaSuraputtrO BaginIputtraH tato BarttfBAgineyaH tato BrAtfputtraH tato jAmAtA tataH SvaSuraH tato BrAtfSvaSuraH tata AnantaryyakrameRa sapiRqAH tataH sakulyAH tataH samAnodakAH .” iti tawwIkAyAM SrIkfzRatarkAlaNkAraH ॥
v: na॰ yoturyogakAlastatra labDaM kaR । vivAhakAle labDe Dane yOtakaSabde dfSyam ।
m: यौतुक n. = यौतक, Mn. ix, 131.

s: puM, (yuvanASvasyApatyamiti । yuvanASva + aR .) mAnDAtfrAjaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ api ca । “yOvanASvo'Ta mAnDAtA cakravarttyavanIpraBuH । saptadvIpavatImekaH SaSAsAcyutatejasA ॥ Ije ca yajYaM kratuBirAtmavidBUridakziREH ॥ sarvvadevamayaM devaM sarvvAtmakamatIndriyam ॥ dravyaM mantro viDiryajYo yajamAnastaTartvijaH । Darmmo deSaSca kAlaSca sarvvametadyadAtmakam ॥ yAvat sUryya udeti sma yAvacca pratitizWati । tat sarvvaM bOvanASvasya mAnDAtuH kzetramucyate ॥ SaSavindorduhitari bindumatyAmaDAnnfpaH । purukutsamambarIzaM mucukundaYca yoginam ॥ tezAM svasAraH paYcASat sOBariM vavrire patim ॥” iti SrIBAgavate 9 skanDe 6 aDyAyaH ॥
m: यौवनाश्व m. (fr. युवनाश्व) patr. of Māndhātṛ, Pravar.; MBh. &c.
of a grandson of Māndhātṛ, BhP. (accord. to Pāṇ. vi, 2, 107, Sch., यौवन + अश्व).
a: यौवनाश्वः — N. of Māndhātṛ, son of Yuvanāśva.

s: puM, (yOvanASva + svArTe kan .) mAnDAtfrAjaH । iti jawADaraH ॥
m: यौवनाश्वक m. patr. of Māndhātṛ, L.
यौवनाश्वि m. id., MBh.; R.
यौवनान्त mfn. ending in youth, having youthfulness at the end, Kum.
यौवनारूढ mfn. one who has arrived at adolescence or puberty, Kathās.
यौवनारम्भ m. the prime of youth, first bloom of youth, juvenility, Mālatīm.
यौवनावस्था f. the state of youth, youthfulness, puberty, MW.
यौवनीय mfn. youthful, juvenile (with द्वार् f. the gates of youth or adolescence), Naiṣ.

s: klI, (yuvan + “hAyanAntayuvAdiByo'R .” 5 । 1 । 130 । iti aR .) yUno BAvaH । tatparyyAyaH । tAru Ryam 2 । ityamaraH ॥ vayaH 3 iti jawADaraH ॥ tattu zoqaSavarzamAraBya saptati-. varzaparyyantama । yaTA, -- “AzoqaSAdBavedvAlastaruRastata ucyate । bfdDaH syAt saptaterUrdDvaM varzIyAn navateH param ॥” iti smftiH ॥ navayOvanalakzaRaM yaTA, -- “darodBinnastanaM kiYcit calAkzaM medurasmitam । manAgaBisPUradBAvaM navyaM yOvanamucyate ॥” ityujjvalanIlamaRiH ॥ (“garBeSvaratvam aBinavayOvanatvamapratirUpatvamamAnuzaSaktitvaYceti mahatIyaM KalvanarTaparamparA । sarvvAvinayAnAmekEkamapyezAmAyatanam । kimuta samavAyaH । yOvanAramBe ca prAyaH SAstrajalaprakzAlananirmmalApi kAluzyamupayAti budDiH । anujJitaDavalatApi sarAgEva Bavati yUnAM dfzwiH । apaharati ca vAtyeva SuzkapatraM samudBUtarajoBrAntiradUramAtmecCayA yOvanasamaye puruzaM prakftiH । indriyahariRahAriRI ca satatamatiduranteyamupaBogamfgatfzRikA । navayOvanakazAyitAtmanaSca salilAnIva tAnyeva vizayasvarUpARyAsvAdyamAnAni maDuratarARyApatanti manasaH । nASayati ca diNmoha ivonmArgapravarttakaH puruzamatyAsaNgo vizayezu .” iti kAdambaryyAM candrApIqaM pratiSukanASopadeSaH ॥) navayOvanakArakamOzaDaM yaTA, -- “aSvaganDAnAgabalAguqamAMsanizeviRAm । rUpaM BavedyaTA tadvat navayOvanacAriRAm ॥” iti gAruqe 189 aDyAyaH ॥
v: na॰ yUno BAvaH aRa । 1 tAruRye “A zoqaSAd Baved bAlastaruRastata ucyate । vfdDaH syAt saptaterUrDvam” ityukte 2 avasTABede ।
m: यौवन n. (fr. युवन्) youth, youthfulness, adolescence, puberty, manhood (also pl. = juvenile deeds or indiscretions; ifc. f(आ). ), AV. &c. &c.
a number of young people (esp. of young women), Pāṇ. iv, 2, 38
N. of the third stage in the Śākta mysteries, Cat.
a: यौवन — a. (नी f.) [य्नो भावः अण्] Young, juvenile. --नं 1 Youth (fig. also), youthfulness, prime or bloom of youth, puberty; मुग्धत्वस्य च यौ वनस्य च सखे मध्ये मधुश्रीः स्थिता V. 2. 7; यौवनेऽभ्यस्तविद्यानां R. 1. 8; 6. 50; दिनयौवनोत्थान् 13. 20. --2 Any youthful or juvenile act. --3 A number of young persons, especially women --Comp. --अंत a. ending in youth, being a prolonged youth; Ku. 6. 44. --अवस्था, --दशा youthfulness, puberty. --आरंभः prime of youth, budding youth; Māl. 3. --उद्भेदः {1} ardour of youthful passions. {2} sexual love. {3} N. of Cupid. --आरंभः prime of youth, budding youth. --दर्पः {1} youthful pride. {2} indiscretion natural to youth. --लक्षणं {1} a sign of youth. {2} charm, loveliness. {3} the female breast. --स्थ a. {1} youthful. {2} marriageable.

k.v: शिशुत्वं शैशवं बाल्यं तारुण्यं यौवनं समे। स्यात्स्थाविरं तु वृद्धत्वं वृद्धसंघेऽपि वार्धकम्.।

m: यौवन—भिन्न-शैशव mfn. whose childhood is separated off by youth, passing from childhood to manhood, MW.
यौवन—श्री f. the beauty of youthfulness, Bhartṛ.
यौवन—दशा f. the period of youth, ib.
यौवन—दर्प m. juvenile pride or indiscretion, Hit.
यौवनक n. = यौवन, g. मनोज्ञादि.

s: puM, klI, (yOvane kaRwakamiva duHKadatvAt .) yuvagaRqaH । iti SabdamAlA vayasPoqA iti BAzA ॥
v: puMna॰ yOvanasya kaRwaka iva cihnam । (vayas PoqA) vraRaBede SabdamA॰
m: यौवन—कण्टक m. n. an eruption or pimples on the face (esp. of young people), L.

s: klI, (yOvanasya lakzaRaM cihnam .) lAvaRyam । stanaH । iti medinI । ne, 117 ॥ tAruRyacihnam ॥
v: na॰ 6 ta॰ । 1 stane 2 lAvaRye ca medi॰ ।
m: यौवन—लक्षण n. ‘sign of youth’, the female breast, L.
loveliness, grace, L.
यौवन—मत्ता f. ‘intoxicated with (the pride of) youth’, N. of a metre, Col.
यौवन—पदवी f. the path of youth (˚वीम् आरूढः, having entered on adolescence), Pañcat.

s: strI, (yOvane piqakA .) yuvakAle muKe jAtaH kzudrasPowakaH । vayasPoqA iti BAzA ॥ (yaTA, suSrute nidAnasTAne । 13 । “yOvanapiqakA padmiRI kaRwakA jatumaRirityAdi ॥”) tallakzaRaM yaTA, -- “SAlmalIkaRwakapraKyAH kaPamArutaSoRitEH । jAyante piqakA yUnAM vaktre yA muKadUzikAH ॥” iti suSrute । 1 । 14 aDyAyaH ॥ asyAScikitsA muKadUzikASabde drazwavyA ॥
m: यौवन—पिडका f. = -कण्टक, Suśr.
यौवन—प्रान्त m. the extreme verge or end of youth, ib.
यौवन—स्थ mfn. being in the (bloom of) youth, arrived at puberty, marriageable, MBh.
यौवन—सुख n. the joys of youth or of love, Mṛcch.
यौवन—वत् mfn. possessing youth, young, youthful, Vet.; Hit.; Kathās.
यौवनिक m. (?) and f(आ). = यौवन, youth, L.
यौवनिन् mfn. youthful, Hariv.; MārkP.
यौवनोद्भेद m. the ardour of youthful passion, L.
the god of love, L.
यौवराजिक mf(आ, or ई)n. (fr. युव-राज), g. काश्य्-आदि.
यौवराज्य n. (fr. युव-राज; ifc. f(आ). ) the rank or office or rights of an heir-apparent, the right of succession to a kingdom, MBh.; R. &c.
a: यौवराज्यं — The rank or rights of an heir-apparent; यौवराज्येऽभिषिक्तः ‘crowned heir-apparent’.

s: klI, (yuvatInAM samUhaH । yuvati + “BikzAdiByo'R .” 4 । 2 । 38 । iti aR । puMvadBAvABAvaSca .) yuvatisamUhaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 22 ॥ (yaTA, gItagovinde । 10 । 15 । “ratistava kalAvatI ruciracitraleKe BruvAvaho vibuDayOvataM vahasi tanvi ! pfTvIgatA ॥” yuvatiBiH kftamiti । nftyaviSezaH । yaTA, saNgItadAmodare । “maDuraM bahulIlABirnawIBiryatra nftyate । vaSIkaraRavidyABaM tallAsyaM yOvataM matam ॥”) parimARam । iti amarawIkAyAM BarataH ॥
v: na॰ yuvatInAM samUhaH aR । yuvatisamudAye amaraH ।
m: 1. यौवत n. (fr. युवति) a number of girls or young women, Gīt. (Pāṇ. iv, 2, 38).
2. यौवत = यौतव, L.
a: यौवतं — [युवतीनां समूहः अण्] 1 An assemblage of young women; अवधृत्य दिवोपि यौवतैर्न सहाधीतवतीमिमामहं N. 2. 41. --2 The quality of a young woman (beauty &c.), the state of being a young woman; अहो विबुधयौवतं वहसि तन्वि पृथ्वीगता Gīt. 10. (सुरसुंदरीरूपं).

k.v: आपन्नसत्त्वा स्याद्गुर्विण्यन्तर्वत्नी च गर्भिणी। गणिकादेस्तु गाणिक्यं गार्भिणं यौवतं गणे॥

m: यौवतेय m. the son of a young woman, Vop.
a: यौवतेयः — The son of a young woman.

m: यौट् (v.l. यौड्) cl. 1. P. यौटति, to join or fasten together, Dhātup. ix, 2 (cf. योटक).

s: f sambanDe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰para॰-saka॰-sew .) caturddaSasvarI । f, ayuyOwat । yOwati kAzWaM takzA । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: saMbanDe BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । bOwati ayOwIt । fdit caNi na hrasvaH ।

m: यौयुधानि m. patr. fr. युयुधान, MBh.
यौषिण्य n. (cf. योषन्) womanhood, BhP.

s: tri, (yuzmad + “yuzmadasmadoranyatarasyAM KaYca .” 4 । 3 । 1 । iti KaY । “tasminnaRi ceti .” 4 । 3 । 2 । iti yuzmAkAdeSaH .) yuzmatsambanDi । yuzmAkamidaM ityarTe RIn pratyayena nizpannam । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥ yuzmacCabde aliKitatvAdavasarasaNgatyA gORayuzmadasmacCabdaprayogo'tra liKyate । yuzmadasmadormuKyatve gORatve ca sijas NeNasAM svarUpagrahaRAt tezu parezu tvAhayUyavayatuByamahyatavamamAH syureva । sijasAMderanyatra yuzmadasmadormuKyatve ekavacane pare tvanmadO dbivacane pare yuvAvO bahuvacane pare svarUpeRAvasTAnam । gORatve tu paraviBaktimanAdftya yuzmadasmadorekatve tvanmadO dvitve yuvAvO bahutve svarUpeRAvasTAnamiti ॥ * ॥ yaTA tvAmatikrAntaH atitvaM atitvAM atiyUyam । atitvAM atitvAM atitvAn । atitvayA atitvAByAM atitvABiH । atituByaM atitvAByAM atitvaByam । atitvat ati tvAByAM atitvat । atitava atitvayoH atitvayAm । atitvayi atitvayoH atitvAsu ॥ * ॥ yuvAmatikrAntaH atitvaM atiyuvAM atiyUyam । atiyuvAM atiyuvAM atiyuvAn । atiyuvayA atiyuvAByAM atiyuvABiH । atituByaM atiyuvAByAM atiyuvaByam । atiyuvat atiyuvAByAM atiyuvat । atitava atiyuvayoH atiyuvayAm । atiyuvayi atiyuvayoH atiyuvAsu ॥ * ॥ yuzmAnatikrAntaH atitvaM atiyuzmAM atiyUyam । atiyuzmAM atiyuzmAM atiyuzmAn । atiyuzmayA atiyuzmAByAM atiyuzmABiH । atituByaM atiyuzmAByAM atiyuzmaByam । atiyuzmat atiyuzmAByAM atiyuzmat । atitava atiyuzmayoH atiyuzmayAm । atiyuzmayi atiyuzmayoH atiyuzmAsu ॥ * ॥ mAmatikrAntaH atyahaM atimAM ativayam । atimAM atimAM atimAn । atimayA atimAByAM atimABiH । atimahyaM atimAByAM atimaByam । atimat atimAByAM atimat । atimama atimayoH atimayAm । atimayi atimayoH atimAsu ॥ * ॥ AvAmatikrAntaH atyahaM atyAvAM ativayam । atyAvAM atyAvAM atyAvAn । atyAvayA atyAvAByAM atyAvABiH । atimahyaM atyAvAByAM atyAvaByam । atyAvat atyAvAByAM atyAvat । atimama atyAvayoH atyAvayAm । atyAvayi atyAvayoH atyAvAsu ॥ * ॥ asmAnatikrAntaH atyahaM atyasmAM ativayam । atyasmAM atyasmAM atyasmAn । atyasmayA atyasmAByAM atyasmABiH । atimahyaM atyasmAByAM atyasmat । atyasmat atyasmAByAM atyasmat । atimama atyasmayoH atyasmayAm । atyasmayi atyasmayoH atyasmAsu । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
m: यौष्माकीन mf(आ)n. id., HPariś. (Pāṇ.; ib.)

s: tri, (yuzmad + aR । “tasminnaRi ca yuzmAkAsmAkO .” 4 । 3 । 2 । iti prakfteryuzmakAdeSaH .) yuzmatsambanDi । yuzmAkamidaM ityarTe zRapratyayena nizpannam । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥ (yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 112 । 205 । “ityAdyasmAsu jalpatsu militezvatra tatkzaRam । vidyADaro DUmaSiKo yOzmAko'vAtaraddivaH ॥”)
v: tri॰ yuzmAkamidam yuzmad + aR yuzmAkAdeSaH । yuzmatsambanDini । KaY । yOzmakIno'pyatra tri॰ । iti SrItArAnATatarkavAcaspatiBawwAcAryya saNkalite vAcaspatye yakArAdiSabdArTasaNkalanam ।
m: यौष्माक mf(ई)n. (fr. युष्म) your, yours, Kathās. (Pāṇ. iv, 3, 1; 2).
a: यौष्माक — a. (की f.) यौष्माकीण a. Your, yours.
